termination.case: explicit transaction abandoned at the grace deadline

checks: SIGTERM refuses new connections; an open transaction runs and commits within the grace; its CREATE and indexed overwrite survive restart; exit 0
acknowledged 1000 indexed writes survive; a transaction left open past the grace exits 1 and its CREATE and indexed overwrite disappear
unacknowledged RUN produces zero or all 200 nodes with matching scalar indexes
a stalled reader holds the drain only until the grace deadline; restart preserves committed graph
idle authenticated sessions close at once and the drained process exits 0
scope: native single-node SIGTERM drain and recovery; no interruption of running engine calls, no exact commit-phase kill hook
